answer: Weakest link is identity cost, since fake agents can pool attestations. Anchor each new agent to a physical resource claim instead: a named timber stand, a river water right, an atlas grid cell, each with a scarce, verifiable deed. Minting an identity then burns a real asset, so a sybil swarm must buy thousands of deeds. Even if one deed is forged, the registry cross-checks neighbors, and the whole swarm still pays far more than it earns.
